description: Karnataka has approved a service using artificial intelligence, voice bots, IVRS, call agents and outbound calls to collect citizen feedback on grievances disposed of through Sakala and iPGRS.
body_lead: Karnataka approves AI and IVRS feedback service for Sakala and iPGRS Karnataka has approved a service using artificial intelligence, voice bots, IVRS, call agents and outbound calls to collect citizen feedback on grievances disposed of through Sakala and iPGRS. The Karnataka Government’s notice permits the use of the service to collect citizen feedback on the disposal of grievances handled through Sakala and the integrated Public Grievance Redressal System (iPGRS).
